---
title: "Iteration-mtcars"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
mtcars
```

























```{r}
classes <- vector("character", ncol(mtcars))

for(i in seq_along(mtcars)) {
  classes[i] <- class(mtcars[[i]])
}
classes
```




```{r}
mtcars |> map(~class(.x))
```























```{r}
mtcars |> map_chr(~class(.x))
```




















```{r}
mtcars |> map_df(~class(.x))
```























```{r}
mtcars |> map_df(~c(class=class(.x)), .id = "var")
```
